gruenalgen.beschreibung: Gutweed (Ulva intestinalis) at low tide in Brofjorden, Govik, Lysekil Municipality, Sweden. The tublar fronds are puffed up by oxygen from photosynthesis. This specimen is about 7 cm (2.8 in) high and it grows on a rusty boat ramp. In this region, the tidal range is about 20 cm (7.9 in).

Large, thin encrusting plates, Membranipora membranacea is a white calcified bryozoan, colonizing the fronds of kelp. Their zooids are rectangular in shape, as seen in these images. Adult colonies can cover several square decimeters, similar to lace, with a rounded edge.
